name: com.driftsys.dashscene
description: The C# side of dashscene. The boundary-B value types, and the host that sits on the C ABI: version negotiation, runtime lifetime, document load, the tick and the committed frame. No painter and no native library yet. See docs/roadmap.md for the slices that add them.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour that loads a .dsb, ticks it, and takes each committed frame. The painter that draws those tables is story #1122.
